messages.author: 5ec5102a43e29af7
messages.subject: scale_x_continuous and xlab
parts:
Hi

why is it not possible to modify an axis label, that was defined by
scale_continuous?

library(ggplot2)
p = ggplot(mtcars,aes(mpg,cyl)) + geom_point() +
scale_x_continuous("MPG")
p + xlab("test")


I am construction a plot and would like to change the labels afterwards
to another language.

Of cource I can use scale_x_continuous a second time, but I am wondering
why xlab doesn't work.

best regards,
stefan

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: scale_x_continuous and xlab
parts:
Hi Stefan,

This is an unfortunate consequence of the new way that labelling
works. I'd suggest just not setting the label in the scales.

Hadley
